$comment: The machine-readable half of docs/LICENCE-POLICY.md. Tiers hold BASE SPDX identifiers; the engine strips -only/-or-later before lookup. Anything absent from every tier is treated as reviewRequired, never as allowed.

buildOverrides.$comment: Tier used ONLY for build-time tooling, which is never distributed. MPL-2.0 is deliberately absent: it stays reviewRequired even in build scope, so the exceptions below are load-bearing rather than decorative.

exceptions.justification: Tailwind v4's CSS engine, invoked at build time via @tailwindcss/vite. It transforms our CSS and contributes no MPL-covered code to the shipped bundle; MPL-2.0 obligations attach to distribution of covered code (MPL section 3), which does not occur. The shipped-scope cross-check fails the build if this package ever enters the runtime tree.

Platform-specific native binary of lightningcss; npm resolves a different optional package per platform (lightningcss-darwin-arm64, lightningcss-linux-x64-gnu, ...), hence the trailing wildcard. Same reasoning as lightningcss.
